Hi Joe & Team

I am facing some issues with the 0.6.0 Shiny version . I installed this to use action button in my application 

My app has 4 tabs . In one of the tabs I am trying to plot a graph and beneath the graph description of variables in the table below . 

However , The code 

In my UI , this is my code

 tabPanel("Graph",textOutput("A1"),

Server.R

}

 a <- reactiveValues()

  output$A2<- renderPlot({ 

  Access a and work
# Final output is a plot
}

Is this a bug or am I missing something here


Thanks
Mayank
